Roah Moonglow is a halfling Trader and member of the Zhentarim who first appears in the Shattered Sanctum within the Goblin Camp.
“
Hm. Are you, by any chance, the bad smell that followed me up from the sewer?
„
— Roah Moonglow

Involvement

Act One

Roah is an unscrupulous trader who has come to the goblin camp with the intention of buying goblin prisoners as slaves and selling Smokepowder. She is disappointed that the goblins are no longer willing to sell their prisoners, since they are now sending them to Moonrise Towers. She is more than willing to trade with the party, if they have coin.

Roah is west of the central chamber of the Shattered Sanctum at X: 275 Y: -29, and is accompanied by her bodyguards,  Erna and  Yerle.

If the party recognize Roah as a member of the Zhentarim, and ⁠Find the Missing Shipment has already been completed, it is possible to bring this up with her and receive the same "friend of the family" discount  Brem provides after that quest.

However, if the party attacked and killed everyone in the Zhentarim Basement, regardless of whether they have completed ⁠Find the Missing Shipment they instead have the option of bringing up the killings in conversation with Roah. If they do, Roah reacts (understandably) negatively and allows the character one last opportunity to trade with her. Subsequent attempts to trade are rebuffed with a threat of reprisals by the Zhentarim, although other party members may still trade with her normally.

If Roah is killed in Act One, the party miss out on purchasing items from her shop in Act Two.

Act Two

The Zhentarim trader can be encountered again in the entry hall of Moonrise Towers at X: -174 Y: -176. Roah mentions the lucrative smuggling she does for the cult of the Absolute. Rogues receive a special dialogue option to use Thieves' Cant to ask for a discount and party members with the  Criminal background receive the inspiration ⁠War Profiteer if a party member trades with Roah.

Act Three

If Roah survives to Act Three she moves to the Abandoned Cistern of the Lower City Sewers and is making a deal with  'Jaheira', after the party has first encountered  Minsc in The Counting House. Although she is part of the ensuing battle, she flees from the sewers if not immediately killed.

It is possible to trade with Roah during the Minsc dialogue preceeding the fight; depending on the party's future choices, it might be the last opportunity to acquire her items. If she is killed, the 10,000 gold pilfered from the Bank Vault is in her inventory.

At the Guildhall, Roah and her Zhentarim attempt to stage a coup to replace  Nine-Fingers Keene as leader of the Guild. After the battle, if Roah survives this conflict, she moves into the former Guild Master's office and resumes being a trader with her existing inventory. After she has assumed her new office, the first time Roah is spoken to, the party can cross her by taking over the Guild, which results in her and the surviving Zhentarim becoming hostile.

If Roah is dead, or dies prior to Act Three, she is replaced by  Friol.

Idle banter

Roah will be occassionally approached by Klagga in Act One

  • Tracker Klagga
    Um. 'Ello. Got any breeches?
  • Roah Moonglow
    That depends - got any coin?
  • Tracker Klagga
    Got nothin'. Kept it all in my old breeches, and somebody robbed 'em!
  • Roah Moonglow
    Here - free of charge. Consider it a public service on my part.
  • Roah Moonglow
    Yours can be keeping them on, hm?

Inside Moonrise Towers, Roah has idle exchanges with her guards.

  • Roah Moonglow
    Smile, Yerle. We're among friends.
  • Yerle
    Too damn friendly, you ask me. Gods-fearing folk ought to be more... fearful.
  • Roah Moonglow
    Why not join this Absolute, see what all the fuss is about?
  • Yerle
    ...I'll stick with the monster I know, thanks.
  • Yerle
    You sure you don't want me to check those crates? Be nice to know what we're shipping.
  • Roah Moonglow
    Erna, remind your sister why I pay you both so much.
  • Erna
    'Minding our business is our business'.
  • Erna
    That bugbear keeps looking over, I'll feed him his own loincloth.
  • Roah Moonglow
    These are our allies, Erna. I'll handle the diplomacy, you just keep looking pretty.
